description: This file defines a PHP class 'smpl_Lead_Sample' responsible for generating a lead sample PDF or HTML template, including methods for retrieving the type, body, header, and footer of the template, with extensive HTML content and localization support.

classes.name: smpl_Lead_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate a lead sample template with HTML content, including methods to get type, body, header, and footer.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'Leads', indicating the type of template.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the lead sample, with dynamic logo URL, localization, and placeholders for lead information.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific footer content.
